description: This file defines the Banner event controller for the OpenCart admin panel. It contains methods to add, edit, and delete banners, each of which schedules a task in the system to process banner data changes.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Controller class for handling banner-related event actions such as adding, editing, and deleting banners, which trigger background tasks.

methods.name: addBanner
methods.description: Schedules a task to process the addition of a new banner, using the output ID.

methods.name: editBanner
methods.description: Schedules a task to process editing an existing banner, using the banner ID from args.

methods.name: deleteBanner
methods.description: Schedules a task to process deletion of a banner, using the banner ID from args.
